facts.en: Completed a customer-facing workplace skills programme at Fictional Peachstone Centre in 2017.
facts.zh: 2017 年在虚构桃石中心完成面向客户的职场技能课程。

facts.en: Paid housekeeping stores assistant at Fictional Sedgehouse Guest Lodge from 2018-05 to 2021-12.
facts.zh: 2018-05 至 2021-12 在虚构莎草屋旅舍任有薪客房用品库助理。

facts.en: At the lodge, issued linen bundles to room attendants and recorded damaged storage containers for replacement.
facts.zh: 在旅舍向客房服务员发放布草包，并记录损坏储物容器以便更换。

facts.en: Paid showroom floor assistant at Fictional Secondbranch Furnishings from 2022-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2026-08 在虚构再枝家具机构任有薪展厅楼面助理。

facts.en: Attached item-reference tags and recorded visible scratches or missing handles on donated furniture.
facts.zh: 为捐赠家具附上物品编号标签，并记录可见划痕或缺失拉手。

facts.en: Measured external height, width and depth for the showroom listing sheet.
facts.zh: 为展厅上架表测量外部高度、宽度及深度。

facts.en: Kept items awaiting workshop review in the designated holding area until the workshop lead marked them ready for display.
facts.zh: 将等待工坊审核的物品留在指定暂存区，直至工坊负责人标记为可展示。

facts.en: Explained recorded dimensions and visible-condition notes to visitors and referred structural questions to the workshop team.
facts.zh: 向访客说明已记录尺寸及可见状况备注，并将结构问题转交工坊团队。

facts.en: Booked collection windows for sold items and attached the customer’s collection reference to the item tag.
facts.zh: 为已售物品预约取货时段，并在物品标签上附上客户取货编号。

facts.en: Reconciled the showroom status board with a colleague during 2025-10.
facts.zh: 2025-10 与一名同事共同核对展厅状态板。

facts.en: The reconciliation covered 35 donated items: 24 on display, 7 awaiting workshop review and 4 sold items awaiting collection.
facts.zh: 该次核对涵盖 35 件捐赠物品：24 件在展示，7 件等待工坊审核，4 件已售物品等待取货。

facts.en: Personally checked the references of the 24 displayed items; the colleague checked the other 11 item references.
facts.zh: 个人核对 24 件展示物品的编号；同事核对另外 11 件物品编号。

facts.en: Uses a tape measure, item-tag printer, spreadsheet status filters and a shared collection calendar.
facts.zh: 使用卷尺、物品标签打印机、电子表格状态筛选及共享取货日历。

facts.en: Helped position light display items and followed the floor lead’s team-handling plan for larger pieces.
facts.zh: 协助摆放轻型展示物品，并对较大件遵循楼面负责人的团队搬运安排。

facts.en: Completed internal item-handling and visitor-route induction in 2022-03.
facts.zh: 2022-03 完成内部物品搬运及访客路线入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Lanternpatch Theatre from 2019-09 to 2020-06, labeling borrowed stage props and checking return lists.
facts.zh: 2019-09 至 2020-06 在虚构灯补剧团做志愿者，为借入舞台道具贴标签并核对归还清单。

facts.en: Helped paint a non-load-bearing cardboard fireplace for that volunteer production, using a designer’s supplied pattern.
facts.zh: 依据设计师提供的图样，协助为该志愿演出使用的不承重纸板壁炉上色。

facts.en: Created a personal miniature room arrangement from recycled boxes in 2024; it was not a commissioned interior-design project.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用回收纸盒制作个人微型房间布置；不是受委托的室内设计项目。

facts.en: Enjoys arranging still-life photographs of household objects.
facts.zh: 爱好布置家居物品静物摄影。

facts.en: Left a closing handover of blocked display spaces, pending collections and items still awaiting workshop review.
facts.zh: 营业结束时交接受阻展示区域、待取物品及仍待工坊审核的物品。
